overview_description.description:
Motion is an AI time management platform that provides real-time interventions, reminders, and analytics. Motion mark sites as distracting to limit the time on them in the future.

The company's tool keeps users from becoming distracted while browsing the web by providing real-time interventions, reminders, and analytics, as well as calendar, tab management, and focus tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Motion is an AI time management platform that provides real-time interventions, reminders, and analytics.

product.name: AI Task Planner
product.description: Automatically detects and prioritizes tasks based on project details, deadlines, and user preferences, creating an optimized daily plan.

product.name: AI Project Manager
product.description: Generates complete projects with tasks, deadlines, and assignees automatically, managing statuses and progress updates.

product.name: AI Meeting Notetaker
product.description: Records meetings, takes accurate notes, generates summaries, action items, and sends follow-up emails automatically.

product.name: AI Docs Assistant
product.description: Transforms unstructured notes and documents into organized tasks and projects, enabling content creation and management.

product.name: AI Calendar Assistant
product.description: Automatically schedules and optimizes daily tasks and meetings by timeblocking projects and tasks on a unified calendar.

product.name: AI Workflows Builder
product.description: Converts Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) documents into actionable workflows and projects with task assignments.
